# acli-py meta

Site-wide lists: statuses, priorities, resolutions, issue types.


## `acli-py meta statuses`

List every status and its category.

```text
acli-py meta statuses [OPTIONS]
```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
| `--output` `[table\|json\|csv\|keys\|jsonl\|markdown]` |  | How to print: table, json, csv, markdown, or keys / jsonl (one per line, for pipes). |

## `acli-py meta issue-types`

List issue types.

```text

```

| Option | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-p`, `--project` `TEXT` |  | Only this project's types. |
| `--json` |  | Print JSON. |
| `--csv` |  | Print CSV. |
